title: OLEANDER Landscape Architecture Design Development Process v1.0 - Candidate
purpose: Develop landscape as a living, graded, drained, accessible, ecological and maintainable site system across seasons and establishment states rather than decorative planting around architecture.
scope_in: site baseline, survey, existing landscape and ecological constraints
outdoor program, movement, accessibility and public-realm experience
topography, grading, earthwork and threshold relationships
surface/subsurface water, drainage and irrigation interfaces
planting structure, species strategy, habitat and seasonal change
hardscape, edges, furniture, structures and material assemblies
microclimate, shade, wind, lighting, wayfinding and utilities coordination
construction protection, establishment, maintenance and in-use adaptation
scope_out: survey, civil, geotechnical or drainage engineering certification
arboricultural/ecological statutory approval when separate specialist authority is required
universal plant palette or climate formula
field survival or biodiversity outcome inferred before establishment/readback
authority_position: CANDIDATE R-E professional-domain process under the existing Professional Domain Process Contract. It is not Current until the existing Evolution, independent review, authorized human adoption and Current readback chain closes; Current architecture must continue to report Landscape Architecture PROCESS_OPEN meanwhile.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim depends on Landscape Architecture professional judgment across one or more of: Site Baseline, Survey and Existing Landscape Authority, Outdoor Program, Movement and Public-realm Structure, Topography, Grading and Threshold Coordination, Water, Drainage, Infiltration and Irrigation Interface, Soil, Rooting and Planting/Ecology System, Hardscape, Furniture, Edges and Landscape Assemblies, Microclimate, Shade, Lighting, Wayfinding and Night Condition, Utilities, Structures, Maintenance and Constructability Coordination, Technical Documentation, Samples, Procurement and Field Establishment, Establishment, Seasonal Readback, Maintenance and Adaptive Management.

stages.stage_name: Site Baseline, Survey and Existing Landscape Authority

stage_body_contract.title_rule: <project> | LAN-00 Site Baseline, Survey and Existing Landscape Authority | <decision / cycle / tested configuration>; generic-only titles are invalid.
stage_body_contract.knowledge_mount_rule: Use the stage knowledge_mount_requirement plus the Current task/claim-scoped Operational Mount; candidate support extensions remain bounded support and canonical knowledge bodies are not copied.
stage_body_contract.native_source_rule: Bind the stage body to required_native_outputs[] and actual editable/native professional source; renders, screenshots, schedules or prose cannot replace geometry, calculation, sample, mockup, field or runtime evidence required by the claim.
stage_body_contract.readback_rule: Separate intended design relation, implemented/native state, observed readback and professional interpretation. Preserve exact revision/configuration, strongest contradiction and claim ceiling.
stage_body_contract.open_failure_rule: Keep unresolved specialist approvals, unknown existing/field conditions, untested performance, sample/site variance and does_not_prove boundaries explicit.
stage_body_contract.verdict_reopen_rule: Bound the verdict to this stage claim_ceiling and reopen affected consumers when a controlling use/geometry/material/environment/interface/source/configuration basis changes.
